[镜头3] 18-25秒 中景 · 长焦85mm · 侧45度+微仰 · 缓移：画面主体：叶青山收回伸出的手落在桌缘，眉弓压低后松开，继续念完军功。摄影机沿长桌外侧小幅移行，让老战友甲的侧肩进入前景，另两人仍在桌边，目光朝屏幕，年轻军装照片留在背景。 西窗自然日光保持，人物轮廓清楚。台词：【叶青山（中速·清晰）："{服役期间荣获集体一等功一次，个人二等功一次，个人三等功两次！}"】。声音：<室内底声>。

[镜头2] 4-6秒 中景 · 长焦85mm · 正面+平视 · 固定：画面主体：叶青山右手抬到额侧发令，甲、乙、丙按口令抬右手敬礼，四人朝合影凝视，嘴唇收紧、眼角泛湿；仪式感、对称构图。 西窗自然日光保持，人物轮廓清楚。台词：【叶青山（短促·有力）："{敬礼！}"】。声音：<衣料摩擦声>。
[镜头3] 6-17秒 中景 · 中长焦50mm · 侧45度+平视 · 缓摇：画面主体：南门被推开，女秘书从门口进到门框内一步并停住，嘴唇快而清晰、目光落在叶青山脸上。叶青山先收右手转向门口，甲、乙、丙依次放下敬礼手转头；女秘书清晰主焦，四人处景深后层，屏幕合影保持。 西窗自然日光保持，人物轮廓清楚。台词：【女秘书（快而清晰·郑重）："{董事长，洪城那边传来消息，今天上午十点，李天阳和一个叫王秀兰的女人去民政局领证结婚了！}"】。声音：<砰的一声推门响>。

[镜头5] 19-24秒 中近景 · 长焦85mm · 侧45度+平视 · 固定：画面主体：女秘书把下巴点下一次，双手在腹前相合，目光落在叶青山脸上，嘴角平直，吐字肯定。叶青山与三位老战友在桌旁焦外保持站立。 西窗自然日光保持，人物轮廓清楚。台词：【女秘书（清晰·下降确认）："{我们已经向民政局那边核实过了，非常确定！}"】。声音：<衣料细响>。

35mm人物关系全景，花白短发、深海军蓝西装的叶青山在画面左侧显示屏旁；三名60+老战友坐在画面右侧会议桌周围，白色平头、炭灰西装的甲在右前，银灰后梳短发、深棕夹克的乙在右中，两鬓花白、深蓝西装的丙在右后，均面向画面左侧；门在右后方。显示屏保留希望小学静态照片。


85mm显示屏近景，屏幕开始轮播山区儿童的静态照片：校舍前的三人合照、教室课桌前的两名儿童、校舍院地的四人合照；叶青山在画外连续说：“据统计，在过去的28年时间里，一共有2365名青罗山区的孩子得到过他的资助和培养，其中，1547人顺利考上大学，走出大山，在城市中立足，遍布全国各地，各行各业！”

assets.prompt: Neutral frontal full length group identity reference photograph of EXACTLY THREE fictional Chinese men in their early to late 60s, standing separately with ample clear gaps, hands empty and relaxed, dignified and upright veteran demeanor, civilian clothes only. Left man: tall slim, long face, close-cropped gray hair, dark navy zip-front jacket, gray shirt, black trousers. Center man: medium stocky, rounded broad face, thin silver hair, dark brown casual blazer and cream shirt, dark trousers. Right man: medium height, angular cheekbones, salt-and-pepper side-part, dark olive casual jacket over light gray shirt, dark trousers. Each whole body and black shoes visible. Neutral gray seamless background, soft neutral lighting, natural mature skin and cloth texture, photoreal live action. No fourth person, no uniforms, no medals, no text, no watermark.

assets.name: YYY｜会议室-空间母版
assets.prompt: Photoreal live action empty contemporary Chinese corporate meeting room in daytime. Wide readable view from the south end looking north. North wall has one large black framed flat display SCREEN showing a plain neutral gray blank image, no writing. A long medium walnut conference table is centered along the south-north axis; three dark leather chairs on the west side facing east toward the screen area, the east side near the north screen has a clear standing strip for a presenter. One hinged dark wood entrance door on the east wall at the south end, visible from the room. Soft daylight through tall windows on the west wall, warm-gray walls, neutral ceiling lights. Clean professional but restrained furniture; table, screen, door and window locations clearly distinct. No people, no logos, no readable text, no collage.

assets.name: YYY｜民政局拍照区-空间母版
assets.prompt: Photoreal live action empty Chinese civil marriage registration photo corner in daytime. A seamless warm RED photo backdrop at the north wall, a simple cream chair placed at right and an open wheelchair-sized clear space immediately to its left; the two positions are aligned side by side for a couple head-and-shoulders portrait. Camera tripod and flash at south front edge, mostly out of view; soft neutral portrait lighting and side daylight. Plain light-gray walls and light tile floor, ordinary public service setting, enough accessible floor space for wheelchair. Readable layout, no people, no writing, no logos, no romantic decor, no wedding ceremony.

assets.name: YYY｜民政局办公室-空间母版
assets.prompt: Photoreal live action empty Chinese civil marriage registration office in daytime. Stable geography from a south-east camera looking north-west: pale wood service counter runs east-west in middle; clerk workspace north behind counter, with ordinary monitor at far left and desk stamp pad, clear empty counter work surface in center; public side south has a clear wheelchair position at screen left and standing partner position at center. On the east wall at the public-side south end is a single hinged light wood entrance door that opens INTO the room; clear floor in front of it for an entering woman to push it inward with her foot. Pale walls, west window soft daylight, quiet neutral overhead lights, light tile floor. No security barrier between wheelchair and counter, no court layout, no people, no visible document text or logo.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-灾区档案照片
assets.prompt: One realistic archival-style still photograph of a Chinese rural mountain area after a severe flood-triggered landslide. Muddy brown floodwater, damaged low village houses partly buried by wet earth, broken slope and scattered timber, distant misty green mountains, overcast natural daylight. The image documents a past disaster without showing injured or dead people, no present-time characters, no heroic action scene. Slightly faded natural photographic color and modest old-photo texture, clear details, landscape composition, no frames, no captions, no date stamp, no text, no logo.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-希望小学照片
assets.prompt: One realistic daytime documentary still photograph of a modest rural hope primary school in green Chinese mountain country. Two-story simple whitewashed school building with blue-gray roof, modest paved schoolyard, green hills beyond, ordinary classroom windows, one accessible low ramp leading to entrance. No modern luxury campus, no city skyline. Natural soft daylight, restrained warm-gray and green colors, truthful photographic surfaces. No people in this particular photograph, no readable school sign, no captions, no watermark, no collage.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-儿童照片甲
assets.prompt: One realistic documentary still photograph of five Chinese rural primary-school children aged about 8 to 11, wearing varied ordinary clean practical blue, muted red and gray casual clothing, standing together in a modest mountain schoolyard, relaxed natural smiles, green hills and simple white school wall softly behind them. Respectful everyday school portrait, natural skin and hair, no hardship exaggeration, no uniforms with logos, no adult, no close crop of bodies, no text, no captions, no watermark. Horizontal photographic composition.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-儿童照片乙
assets.prompt: One realistic documentary still photograph of three Chinese rural primary-school children aged about 7 to 10 sitting at a simple worn wooden classroom desk with ordinary school exercise books open, looking up toward the photographer with curious relaxed smiles. A girl with short bob on left, a boy with short hair center, a girl with two small braids on right; modest everyday light blue, beige and muted green clothes. Soft daytime window light, simple white classroom wall in background. Photographic natural faces, no adult, no readable writing, no logos, no watermark, horizontal composition.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-年轻李天阳迷彩照
assets.prompt: Use the FIRST supplied image only as Li Tianyang facial identity and bone-structure source, then create an in-story archival portrait photograph of the SAME fictional Chinese man in his youth, visually about 30, before the rescue injury: preserve recognizable brow, eyes, nose and jaw family, black short military haircut, younger natural skin, no gray hair and no burn scar. Waist-up frontal portrait in a plain Chinese military camouflage field jacket, restrained green/brown camouflage, no invented medals or readable unit insignia. Neutral outdoor barracks greenery softly blurred; authentic slightly faded photographic color. This is a historical photograph displayed on a meeting-room screen, not present-day Li Tianyang and not a new scene; produce the photograph itself with no screen, border, caption, text, logo or watermark. One man only, natural unembellished expression. Do not inherit the source wheelchair, present-day cardigan, pose, gray studio background or lighting.

assets.name: YYY｜屏幕-李天阳与儿童合影
assets.prompt: Create ONE documentary group photograph. The FIRST supplied image controls only current Li Tianyang identity, half-gray hair, HIS OWN RIGHT-cheek healed burn scar, gray shirt/navy cardigan and manual wheelchair. The SECOND supplied image controls only the mountain primary-school architecture, schoolyard and green hills. Do not inherit the first image studio background or the second image empty-yard state. Place Li Tianyang seated naturally in the same wheelchair at the center of the schoolyard, full wheelchair visible, both legs passively covered by dark trousers, feet on footrests, NEVER standing. Exactly five Chinese primary-school children aged 8 to 11 stand naturally beside and slightly behind him, all clearly separate, in modest varied blue, beige, muted red, green and gray everyday clothes. Li Tianyang and children look toward the photographer with warm natural smiles. Photoreal live action, ordinary soft daytime light, natural skin and fabric. This is only a static group photograph later shown on the meeting-room display. Do not add a meeting room, frame, readable sign, caption, text, logo or watermark; no collage.

testSetup.scenario: 同一《六十大婚》第一集三场：会议室、民政局证件照拍摄区、登记办公室；仿真人对白、群像与道具动作
testSetup.agentConfigurationSource: 用户提供的本次运行配置；生成平台回执不含Agent模型和推理强度字段
testSetup.isolationProtocol: 不读取历史Codex或永久记忆；每路仅用对应创作套件及包内依赖，独立子Agent上下文，不引入跨套创作内容
testSetup.isolationBoundary: 根Agent统一MCP执行；李先生恢复阶段曾见跨路库存数量摘要，未读取或采用其他路创作提示词/资产，不能宣称绝对零接触已审计
testSetup.assembly: 成功片保留，按剧情原序全段直拼，无额外艺术剪辑
